fields.description: Global for all profiles: the document type the POS screen creates (Sales Invoice or POS Invoice). POS Next's POS Invoices post their own stock and GL entries on submit, so they behave like Sales Invoices while keeping POS traffic out of the Sales Invoice list. Changing it is blocked while shifts are open, offline invoices are pending, or legacy unconsolidated POS Invoices exist.
fields.label: Invoice Type Created via POS Screen

fields.description: Global for all profiles: the metric monthly targets are measured against (Net Sales, Gross Profit, or Net Profit). Net Sales is the current behaviour (net including tax). Existing target numbers are not migrated when the basis changes.
fields.label: Monthly Target Basis
fields.options:
Net Sales
Gross Profit
Net Profit

fields.description: Global for all profiles: the metric the overall (payback) target is measured against (Net Sales, Gross Profit, or Net Profit). Net Profit reads the outlet company's full P&L and cannot be narrowed by POS Profile. Existing target numbers are not migrated when the basis changes.
fields.label: Overall (Payback) Target Basis
fields.options:
Net Sales
Gross Profit
Net Profit

fields.description: Frappe naming series for new POS Invoices, e.g. INV-.YYYY.-. Empty keeps the default ACC-PSINV-.YYYY.-.
fields.label: POS Invoice Naming Series

fields.description: Frappe naming series for POS Opening Shift documents, e.g. OS-.YY.-.#######. Empty keeps the default POSA-OS-.YY.-.#######.
fields.label: Opening Shift Naming Series

fields.description: Frappe naming series for POS Closing Shift documents, e.g. CS-.YY.-.#######. Empty keeps the default POSA-CS-.YY.-.#######.
fields.label: Closing Shift Naming Series

fields.description: Enable selling items even when stock reaches zero or below. Integrates with ERPNext negative stock settings.
fields.label: Allow Negative Stock

fields.description: Maximum days in the past an outlet may set the Stock Opname posting date. Blank falls back to 2.
fields.label: Stock Opname Max Backdate Days

fields.description: POS terminals refresh stock quantities from the server in the background. The interval stays a per-device setting on the POS.
fields.label: Enable Automatic Stock Sync

fields.description: Items with zero or negative stock (including product bundles) are greyed out and cannot be selected on the POS screen. Overrides Allow Negative Stock on the POS screen.
fields.label: Block Out-of-Stock Items

fields.description: Modes of payment the cashier enters a Modal Awal for when opening a shift. Other modes open at 0. If empty, only the POS Profile's cash mode.
fields.label: Modal Awal Payment Modes

fields.description: The next shift on the same POS Profile on the same day sees the previous closing's expected cash and enters the amount received. Off: every opening enters Modal Awal manually.
fields.label: Cash Handover Between Shifts

fields.description: Select languages available in the POS language switcher. If empty, defaults to English and Indonesian.
fields.label: Allowed Languages

fields.description: Enable cart-wide discount
fields.label: Allow Additional Discount

fields.description: Enable item-level discount in edit dialog
fields.label: Allow Item Discount

fields.description: Show discounts as percentages
fields.label: Use Percentage Discount

fields.description: Maximum discount percentage (enforced in UI)
fields.label: Max Discount Percentage Allowed

fields.description: Allow user to edit item rate in cart. Rate editing is automatically disabled when promotional offers are applied to an item.
fields.label: Allow User To Edit Rate

fields.description: Apply eligible offers (Promotional Schemes / Pricing Rules) to the POS cart automatically. When unchecked, the cashier switches each offer on from the Offers dialog.
fields.label: Auto Apply Offers

fields.description: Cashiers need a head office code to give a manual discount. Only a System Manager can change this.
fields.label: Require Code for Discount

fields.description: Audit-only mode for the server-side offer price replay (SEC-23): magnitude mismatches between the submitted rate and the server-replayed offer rate are logged instead of rejected. Leave unchecked (default) to enforce and reject manipulated submissions.
fields.label: Price Replay Audit Only

fields.description: Number of decimal places for amounts
fields.label: Decimal Precision

fields.description: Automatically set taxes as included in item prices. When enabled, displayed prices include tax amounts.
fields.label: Tax Inclusive

fields.description: Split a POS Package price across its component lines, proportionally to each component's POS price-list value, so item-level sales reporting sees the revenue (the package header line drops to zero). Disabled keeps the legacy behaviour: the whole price sits on the header line and components are free.
fields.label: Allocate Package Price to Components

fields.description: Allow customers to buy on credit (negative balance/debt)
fields.label: Allow Credit Sale

fields.description: Allow customers to use their positive credit balance (from returns/overpayments) as payment
fields.label: Allow Customer Credit Payment

fields.description: Enable partial payment for invoices
fields.label: Allow Partial Payment

fields.description: When enabled, non-cash payments (card, bank transfer) require exact amount. Cash payments can still have change. Cannot be used with Credit Sale or Partial Payment.
fields.label: Use Exact Amount for Non-Cash

fields.description: Enable product returns
fields.label: Allow Return

fields.description: Number of days allowed for invoice returns. Set to 0 for unlimited returns.
fields.label: Return Validity Days

fields.description: Process returns without invoice reference
fields.label: Allow Return Without Invoice

fields.description: Cashiers need a head office code to make a return. Only a System Manager can change this.
fields.label: Require Code for Refund

fields.description: Enable sales order creation
fields.label: Allow Create Sales Order

fields.description: Select from existing sales orders
fields.label: Allow Select Sales Order

fields.description: Don't create invoices, only orders
fields.label: Create Only Sales Order

fields.description: Accept customer purchase orders
fields.label: Allow Customer Purchase Order

fields.description: Permit duplicate customer names
fields.label: Allow Duplicate Customer Names

fields.description: Automatically apply eligible coupons
fields.label: Auto Fetch Coupon Gifts

fields.description: Disabled: No sales person selection. Single: Select one sales person (100%). Multiple: Select multiple with allocation percentages.
fields.label: Sales Persons Selection

fields.description: Enable loyalty program features for this POS profile
fields.label: Enable Loyalty Program

fields.description: Loyalty program for this POS profile
fields.label: Loyalty Program

fields.description: Receivable account for customer wallets
fields.label: Wallet Account

fields.description: Automatically create wallet for new customers (always enabled when loyalty program is active)
fields.label: Auto Create Wallet

fields.description: Automatically convert earned loyalty points to wallet balance. Uses Conversion Factor from Loyalty Program (always enabled when loyalty program is active)
fields.label: Convert Loyalty Points to Wallet

fields.description: Enable delivery fee calculation
fields.label: Use Delivery Charges

fields.description: Automatically calculate delivery fee
fields.label: Auto Set Delivery Charges

fields.description: Show items in card view by default
fields.label: Default Card View

fields.description: Show item codes in the UI
fields.label: Display Item Code

fields.description: Show item variants directly in the item grid instead of their template items. When disabled, template items are shown and variants are selected via a variant selector.
fields.label: Show Variants as Items

fields.description: Show quantity input field
fields.label: Use QTY Input

fields.description: Show discount as percentage
fields.label: Display Discount %

fields.description: Show discount value
fields.label: Display Discount Amount

fields.description: Display customer balance on screen
fields.label: Show Customer Balance

fields.description: Hide expected cash amount in closing
fields.label: Hide Expected Amount

fields.description: Limit search results for performance
fields.label: Use Limit Search

fields.description: Maximum number of search results
fields.label: Search Limit Number

fields.description: Driver used for silent printing
fields.label: Print Driver

fields.description: Behavior after a sale: Auto prints the receipt immediately, Manual prints from the success dialog, Off does not print
fields.label: Print Mode

fields.description: Print without dialog
fields.label: Enable Silent Print

fields.description: Reprint the last invoice
fields.label: Allow Print Last Invoice

fields.description: Print invoices before submission
fields.label: Allow Print Draft Invoices

fields.description: On failure, fall back down the chain (iMin → QZ → Browser)
fields.label: Enable Print Fallback

fields.description: Print a daily queue number on receipts from this outlet. Numbers are counted per company per day.
fields.label: Enable POS Queue Number

fields.description: Effective print width in dots (multiple of 8, max 576)
fields.label: iMin Custom Dots

fields.description: Copies printed per transaction (customer copy first, then crew/outlet copy)
fields.label: Print Copies

fields.description: Pause between copies so the cashier can tear the first copy off (ms); configurable per POS Profile and overridable per-device (default 800)
fields.label: Delay Between Copies (ms)

fields.description: Print one crew slip after the customer copies, independent of the copy count.
fields.label: Print Crew Slip

fields.description: Pause before the crew slip so the receipt can be torn off (ms), added on top of the estimated time the receipt needs to print. Raise it if the slip comes out with no gap. 0-10000.
fields.label: Delay Before Crew Slip (ms)

fields.description: Gap between the queue number and the content below it, in dots (dots = mm x 8, e.g. 40 = 5 mm). Applies to the customer receipt and the crew slip alike. 0-128.
fields.label: Queue Number Gap (dots)

fields.description: bitmap = receipt is drawn as an image (exact print-format look, slower). text = receipt is sent as printer text commands with only the logo as an image (much faster, uses the printer's own monospace font). Text mode needs the invoice data, so it applies to the POS receipt and crew slip; closing reports stay bitmap.
fields.label: iMin Print Mode

fields.description: How fast the iMin head pushes paper, in dots per second (8 dots = 1 mm). Used only to wait for one sheet to finish before the next sheet (copy / crew slip) starts. Too low = idle wait between sheets; too high = the tear-off pause gets swallowed. 100-2000.
fields.label: Printer Speed (dots/second)

fields.description: Font scale for bitmap printing (percent). Receipt CSS is authored at 96 DPI and translated to the 205 DPI head; 100 = as authored. Raise if text still prints small. VERIFY ON DEVICE.
fields.label: Font Scale (%)

fields.description: Font scale for the crew copy only (percent) — the short order slip the outlet keeps. Default 100 = the same size as the customer receipt; raise if the crew wants it chunkier. 60–250.
fields.label: Crew Copy Font Scale (%)

fields.description: Vertical density of the printed receipt and crew copy (percent). 100 = as authored; lower (e.g. 80) tightens the line spacing without shrinking the text. 50–150.
fields.label: Line Spacing (%)

fields.description: Paper advance after each copy so the receipt clears the tear bar (dots = mm×8, e.g. 100≈12mm)
fields.label: Advance Paper (dots)

fields.description: White space appended inside the bitmap so the last line clears the tear bar (dots = mm×8, e.g. 24≈3mm). Added to the feed advance; not clamped by the SDK's 0..255 limit. VERIFY ON DEVICE.
fields.label: Tail Spacer (dots)

fields.description: Left and right print margin in dots (dots = mm×8, e.g. 16≈2mm). Overrides the padding the receipt format's own CSS sets on either side, so text uses more of the paper width. 0–64. VERIFY ON DEVICE.
fields.label: Side Margin (dots)

fields.description: Blank space above the receipt content, in dots (dots = mm x 8, e.g. 16 = 2 mm). 0 keeps the format's own top padding.
fields.label: Top Margin (dots)

fields.description: bitmap = closing report is drawn as an image. text = closing report is sent as printer text commands (faster, monospace).
fields.label: EOD Print Mode

fields.description: Copies printed for the Closing/EOD receipt — a separate print lane from the per-transaction copies. 1 = the report goes to the manager only. 1–5.
fields.label: EOD Print Copies

fields.description: Pause between EOD copies so the cashier can tear the first one off (ms); overridable per-device. 0–10000.
fields.label: EOD Delay Between Copies (ms)

fields.description: Font scale for the EOD receipt (percent), same 96 DPI authoring as the sales receipt; 100 = as authored. The EOD list is longer, so lower values fit more lines per page. 60–250.
fields.label: EOD Font Scale (%)

fields.description: Vertical density of the printed EOD receipt (percent). 100 = as authored; lower (e.g. 80) tightens the line spacing without shrinking the text. 50–150.
fields.label: EOD Line Spacing (%)

fields.description: Paper advance after the EOD receipt so it clears the tear bar (dots = mm×8, e.g. 160≈20mm). 8–500.
fields.label: EOD Advance Paper (dots)

fields.description: White space appended inside the EOD bitmap so the last line clears the tear bar (dots = mm×8). Added to the feed advance; not clamped by the SDK's 0..255 limit. VERIFY ON DEVICE.
fields.label: EOD Tail Spacer (dots)

fields.description: Left and right print margin for the EOD receipt in dots (dots = mm×8, e.g. 16≈2mm). 0 is edge-to-edge. 0–64. VERIFY ON DEVICE.
fields.label: EOD Side Margin (dots)

fields.description: Blank space above the EOD report content, in dots (dots = mm x 8). 0 keeps the format's own top padding.
fields.label: EOD Top Margin (dots)

fields.description: Lock the POS screen after a period of inactivity or when the browser tab loses focus
fields.label: Enable Session Lock

fields.description: Minutes of inactivity before the session is locked
fields.label: Session Lock Timeout (minutes)

fields.description: Submit invoices in background
fields.label: Allow Submissions in Background Job

fields.description: Delete offline saved invoices
fields.label: Allow Delete Offline Invoice

fields.description: Modify invoice posting date
fields.label: Allow Change Posting Date

fields.description: Pre-filled supplier when the cashier creates a Purchase Order from the POS
fields.label: Default Supplier

fields.description: Default delivery warehouse for POS Purchase Orders (falls back to the POS Profile warehouse)
fields.label: Default Purchase Warehouse

fields.description: Buying price list for POS Purchase Orders (empty = the supplier's default price list applies)
fields.label: Default Buying Price List

fields.description: Only show the POS Receive button on a Purchase Order once the supplier's Delivery Note exists (intercompany flow)
fields.label: Receive Requires Delivery Note
